title: Normalized automorphism inverse comparisons through coefficient descent
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D of characteristic p [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠p, an algebraic closure Ω/Q_l, a separated finite-type D.k-scheme T [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and a scheme automorphism e of T. Assume l invertible in every residue field of T. Use the actual integral, rational and common-stage pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], their coefficient categories [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and a normalized comparison system C [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data]. There exist integral inverse-composition natural isomorphisms a_E: e_E^* ⋙ (e^{-1})_E^* ≅ Id for every finite coefficient field E. Their ambient components are the inverse compositor for (e^{-1},e), followed by transport along e^{-1}e=Id and the specified unit. There also exist rational inverse-composition isomorphisms b_E whose components are the localizations of the components of a_E, and a common-stage inverse-composition isomorphism c whose component at each literal pair (E,K) is the inclusion of (b_E)_K. No arbitrary inverse-equivalence unit replaces the specified compositor and unit.

proof.text: At a finite stage of a literal pair, compare the epsilon of the field-transport family with the independently selected finite witness. Integral component normalization, full-subcategory morphism extensionality, NatTrans.ext and Iso.ext identify these epsilon isomorphisms. Their rational epsilon formulas then identify their rational components. Map that equality through the inclusion functor and compose with the existing common-stage epsilon formula. The resulting isomorphisms are the requested a, b and c.

lean.statement:
theorem automorphismInverseComparisonDescent
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (l ≠ D.p)]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (C : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of D.k))) [IsSeparated T.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom]
    [QuasiCompact T.hom]
    [∀ x : T.left, Invertible (l : T.left.residueField x)] (e : Aut T.left) :
    ∃ a : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E],
        constructibleIntegralPullback l E e.hom ⋙ constructibleIntegralPullback l E e.inv ≅ 𝟭 _,
      (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E T.left),
        ((a E).hom.app K).hom =
          ((integralComparisonComposition l E C e.inv e.hom K).symm ≪≫
            eqToIso (congrArg (fun g ↦ (integralDerivedPullback l E g).obj K.obj)
              e.inv_hom_id) ≪≫ integralComparisonUnit l E C T.left K).hom) ∧
      ∃ b : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E],
          rationalDerivedPullback l E e.hom ⋙ rationalDerivedPullback l E e.inv ≅ 𝟭 _,
        (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
          (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E T.left),
          HEq ((b E).hom.app K)
            ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E T.left).map ((a E).hom.app K.obj))) ∧
        ∃ c : commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.hom ⋙
            commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω e.inv ≅ 𝟭 _,
          ∀ K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω T.left,
            HEq (c.hom.app K)
              ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
                (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := T.left) K.stage).map
                ((b (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω K.stage)).hom.app
                  K.obj))
